peccato, Justitia exigat : Genef. II, 17. Deut. XXVII, 26.

Unus mortuus est pro omnibus. 2, Corinth. V, 15.

page.notes: Hebrew phrase after "1,Joh. II, 1." is שַׂר שָׁלוֹם (Sar shalom); the glyphs are small and the first word is uncertain, so it is marked [?].
